concept.observed: A short poem about what makes a house a home, staged as a paper theatre: curtains open on a silhouette village, a figure walks home, lights come on, smoke curls, the sky turns from dusk to night and morning; captions change on a hanging sign; curtains close.
concept.interpreted: Gentle, nostalgic storytelling for vertical social video.

communication_style.observed: Italic serif lines on a hanging sign, one or two lines at a time; no voice.

palette.observed: Deep reds of the curtains, warm browns, dusk purple-blues; measured luma 0.25.
palette.interpreted: Warm interior against a cooling sky: home versus world.

typography.observed: Italic serif on a dark plaque suspended by ropes.

composition.observed: Portrait stage: sign at the top, stage set in the middle, ground at the bottom; curtains at the sides.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Flat silhouettes (hills, house, figure, trees) with paper-like layering.

motion.observed: Slow walk cycle, house assembling, windows lighting in sequence, sun and moon arcs, smoke curl, door opening with light spill, birds and stars.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: No hard cuts; 12 soft boundaries; static hold 15.42-16.08 s.
timing_and_rhythm.interpreted: Paced for reading short poem lines.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 12 boundaries (0 cut, 0 grow, 1 cover, 11 continuous). 2.08 s continuous: the curtains have parted (about 0-2 s, a cover) and a caption board lowers from the top in about 0.2 s (2.12-2.26 s). 5.58 s continuous: the sky light shifts; nothing else. 6.58 s continuous: a house silhouette fades up and the board's line dissolves to the next one (6.42-6.76 s). 10.75 s continuous: the pink sky holds; the caption line changes in place. 34.08 s continuous: time-lapse on the held stage: the sky turns from night to day in about 0.3 s. 35.08 s continuous: the sky turns towards dusk. 36.08 s continuous: back to a warm day. 37.08 s continuous: to night; the moon appears. 38.08 s continuous: to day. 39.08 s continuous: to dusk; the cycle stops. 55.08 s cover: the curtains close (about 55.0-56.1 s). 56.25 s continuous: the closed curtain fades to black (56.1-56.4 s). Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Curtain open (about 0-2 s) and close (about 55-57 s); time-of-day colour shifts instead of cuts.
transitions.interpreted: One stage for 57 s: the curtain is the only cover, and the sky cycling once per second (34-39 s) shows days passing without a cut.

depth_and_layering.observed: Three to five silhouette planes; a camera pull-back reveals more of the village.

camera.observed: Slow pull-back late in the piece.

audio_and_sync.observed: Spectrogram viewed: discrete sustained notes and chord changes, fade-in over the first 2 s and fade-out at the end aligned with the curtains; a few high transients mid-piece. Boundaries not near onsets (0.17 vs 0.19 chance).
audio_and_sync.interpreted: Instrumental bed (piano-like), no narration; curtains and music fades bookend together.

motifs.observed: Lights coming on; the hanging sign.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -23.2 LUFS, LRA 1.8 LU, true peak -8.6 dBTP (quiet and gentle). 25 accents (26.3 a minute). Accents on cuts 0.08 against chance 0.08 (12 boundaries); onsets near boundaries 0.17 against 0.19. Silence 56.38-57.0 s at the end; head -3.5 dB, tail +0.3 dB. Listen sheet: accents fall on the sign's lines changing (6.97-7.57 s, a second line at 10.05 s, 12.21-12.56 s), the moon and lit windows (16.72-20.06 s) and the door light opening (26.73-27.56 s), not on scene changes.
sound_design.interpreted: The music marks each new line of the poem and each light that comes on; the edit is silent.

narration.observed: Sparse by the numbers: 7 words in 5 phrases, 13% coverage, 0.94 words/s while 'speaking', pace over thirds 0.17/0.11/0.11 words/s (slows), 4 pauses with median 11.7 s and maximum 22.2 s; cuts in pauses 0.73 against chance 0.86. Every phrase frame (1.0-3.4, 5.9-8.0, 28.8-30.1, 31.3-31.7, 53.9-55.1 s) shows the poem on the hanging sign. One-word phrases at those times look like dictation over the music rather than a reading voice, but that cannot be settled with this recogniser. Verdict: probably none.
narration.interpreted: If a voice does read the poem it is far quieter than the music; the Mac re-run decides.

captions.observed: The poem is the caption: a dark wooden plaque hung on ropes in the top band (about 3-12% of the portrait height), italic serif, centred, 1-2 lines; a second line is added under the first (10.05 s); the text changes with the scene; no highlight, no voice to time it against.
captions.interpreted: A diegetic caption plate in the top band keeps the stage below it clear for the silhouette play.

scenes.observed: Curtains open on the stage; first caption.
Figure walks home; house, windows, smoke and sky change with successive captions.
Night and morning cycle; pull-back to the village; closing captions.

difficult: Walk cycle of the silhouette figure (needs a cycle or rig)
uncertainties: Whether the high transients are SFX (birds, door) or part of the music
